codeSystem.name: PlanDefinitionConditionTypes
codeSystem.title: PlanDefinition Action Condition Types
codeSystem.description: A closed, curated set of PlanDefinition.action.condition types an author can select from when authoring a workflow-definition.yaml (see clinuxflow-api/docs/SPEC-18-PLANDEFINITION-AUTHORING-VIA-YAML-PIPELINE.md §7 step 4) — never free-text FHIRPath. Each concept's `code` is itself the canonical Expression.reference URI a compiled PlanDefinition.action.condition.expression.reference should hold; the actual FHIRPath template each code expands to lives separately in condition-type-templates.json, since that mapping isn't itself FHIR content, it's ClinixFlow-specific assembly logic. Deliberately a small starter set, not exhaustive — extend as real condition needs are named, not preemptively (same discipline abdmSchema.js's own option lists already use).

concept.definition: True when the encounter's specialty matches a specific value — SPEC-13 (docs/SPEC-13-FHIR-WORKFLOW-DOCUMENTS-AND-CONFORMANCE.md) §2.1's motivating case: gating Consultation's specialty-specific sections.

concept.display: At least one provider is actively affiliated
concept.definition: True when the facility has at least one PractitionerRole with active=true and period covering now — the roster-liveness precondition discussed for gating Consultation on Provider Registration (SPEC-18 §5, SPEC-13's roster/affiliation-machine discussion). Not 'roster registration complete' — the roster never completes by design.

contains.display: At least one provider is actively affiliated

templates._comment: NOT a FHIR resource — ClinixFlow-specific assembly data only, consumed when compiling a captured condition-type selection (from condition-types.json's CodeSystem) into the real PlanDefinition.action.condition.expression FHIRPath at extraction time. Each key is a condition-types.json concept's `code` (the Expression.reference URI). `{param}`-style placeholders are filled from a companion captured field when the condition needs one (e.g. which specialty) — not built/wired yet, see clinuxflow-api/docs/SPEC-18-PLANDEFINITION-AUTHORING-VIA-YAML-PIPELINE.md §7 step 4's open items. FHIRPath expressions below are illustrative/draft quality — written against the real shard-graph paths and the real clinic-specialties CodeSystem url, but NOT run through a real FHIRPath engine this session — verify before relying on them.

http://yaxb.ai/clinixkernel/Expression/s.parameterSource: The specialtyCode value should be one of clinic-specialities.json's own numeric `code` values (e.g. "2" for Cardiology) — same catalog, reused, not a second vocabulary.
